name: jfk-kgb-lbj-memo.pdf
description: This document is a declassified-era FBI/Justice Department collection on Soviet and Communist Party reactions to President Kennedy's assassination, covering the Warren Commission, Oswald's Soviet history, Yuri Nosenko, and Progressive Labor, Pravda, and Izvestia commentary, dated 1963–1966.

metadata.title: Hoover Memo on the KGB and LBJ
